experiment_data.hypothesis: KL-normalized Lagrangian distillation at 30% sparsity target on Qwen2.5-14B (seed 123) will produce a predictor that achieves comparable downstream quality to dense baseline while pruning ~30% of SwiGLU intermediate activations.

reproduce.command: bash -c "source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && cd /root/distill_sparse_swiglu && export HF_HOME=/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache && export HF_DATASETS_OFFLINE=1 && export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 && export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 && export WANDB_MODE=disabled && export PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 && python -u src/train.py --model_name_or_path /root/autodl-tmp/models/qwen2.5-14b/ --loss_type kl_normalized --num_steps 1000 --batch_size 1 --seq_len 2048 --lr 1e-3 --seed 123 --sparsity_target 0.3 --lambda_max 5000 --gradient_checkpointing --dataset wikitext-103 --log_every 10 --output_dir checkpoints/qwen14b_kl30_s123 --gpu 0 2>&1"
